spec.description: Overview of all numeric PostgreSQL settings using the settings_num metric. Each setting is a separate time series with the setting name as a label, eliminating the cardinality explosion of the legacy 'settings' metric.

spec.title: AV Vacuum Scale Factor
spec.description: Fraction of table size triggering VACUUM

spec.title: AV Vacuum Threshold
spec.description: Min dead tuples before VACUUM

spec.title: Server Version Num
spec.description: Integer encoding of PG version, e.g. 160005 = 16.5

spec.title: AV Analyze Scale Factor
spec.description: Fraction of table size triggering ANALYZE

spec.title: AV Analyze Threshold
spec.description: Min changed rows before ANALYZE

spec.title: WAL Level
spec.description: 1=minimal  2=replica  3=logical

spec.title: Archive Mode
spec.description: 1=off  2=on  3=always

spec.title: Checkpoint Timeout
spec.description: Max time between automatic checkpoints (seconds)

spec.title: Checkpoint Completion Target
spec.description: Fraction of checkpoint_timeout to spread I/O over

spec.title: Min WAL Size
spec.description: In MB

spec.title: Max WAL Size
spec.description: In MB

spec.title: Statement Timeout
spec.description: 0 = disabled

spec.title: Lock Timeout
spec.description: 0 = disabled

spec.title: Shared Buffers
spec.description: In 8 kB blocks. 1 block = 8 KB.

spec.title: Log Autovacuum Min Duration
spec.description: 0 = log all autovacuums; -1 = disabled

spec.title: All Settings (current snapshot)
spec.description: All numeric PostgreSQL settings collected by settings_num. Each row is one setting; name is a Prometheus label.

spec.title: Settings Changed in Time Range
spec.description: Settings whose value changed at least once in the selected time range. Uses Prometheus changes() function.

spec.title: Setting Value Over Time: $setting
spec.description: History of a single setting value over time. Use the $setting variable to select which setting to inspect.

spec.title: Work Mem
spec.description: In kB. Per sort / hash operation.

spec.title: Maintenance Work Mem
spec.description: In kB. Used by VACUUM, CREATE INDEX, etc.

spec.title: Effective Cache Size
spec.description: In 8 kB blocks. Planner estimate of OS + PG cache.

spec.title: Settings Overview
